subject: Two-handed axe warrior

generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Warwrit W03 static full-body combat sprite, a single isolated transparent cutout.
Primary request: create one adult human warrior wielding a practical TWO-HANDED AXE with BOTH hands firmly wrapping the same long wooden haft. No shield. W03's role is a heavy close-range strike against a protected target.
Input images: Image 1 (unit-c-ink.png) is the approved human anatomy, credible equipment proportions, ink-and-flat-wash style and linework reference. Preserve its grounded adult realism and readable rough silhouette, but replace sword and shield with the two-handed axe. Image 2 (staraya-melnitsa.png) is only the shared material, palette and upper-left lighting reference; do not draw any scene or building. Image 3 (battle-ux-v3.png) is the approved elevated three-quarter battlefield camera and scale/readability reference, not a UI or background target.
Subject: one rugged adult man in a worn soot-umber quilted gambeson, leather belt, dark practical trousers and weathered boots; restrained exposed chainmail at collar optional. Credible proportions, no heroic bulging muscles. Both feet planted in a compact staggered combat stance. Head, torso and toes face screen UPPER-RIGHT. Both bent arms hold a long straight hardwood axe haft diagonally across the front of his body, hands clearly separated along its lower half; the axe head projects toward upper-right with a clear silhouette. Ordinary battle axe, one modest broad iron cutting blade with a blunt poll, securely mounted to the haft. Axe haft about shoulder-height in physical length, blade head physically plausible and clearly larger than a one-hand hatchet, no giant fantasy blade, no double-bladed axe. A calm ready pose before a heavy strike, not midair or wildly swinging.
Style/medium: serious grounded dark fantasy hand-painted 2D sprite; irregular dark ink contours, crisp internal hatching, flat wash and strong shadow masses; match approved fighter C. Matte weathered iron, rough cloth, worn leather and wood. Muted soot, slate, umber, ochre with very restrained rust.
Composition/framing: fixed elevated three-quarter view matching battlefield reference; see top of head, shoulders and boots. Entire figure and all axe parts visible with ample margins. One figure centered on a square canvas. Human must read when body is only 80 pixels tall; prioritize compact silhouette, visible both-hand grip and recognizable axe. Full-body, grounded boots, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: upper-left light, restrained highlights and substantial dark shadows. Do not mirror reference lighting.
Scene/backdrop: true transparent alpha background, no ground or background of any kind.
Constraints: exactly one warrior, exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Both hands visibly grip the SAME axe haft. NO sword, NO shield, NO secondary weapon. No ground tile, pedestal, terrain patch, painted contact shadow, border, text, UI, heraldry, symbols, glow, magic, franchise imagery, glossy photorealism, cute rounded forms or clean pale materials. Preserve alpha in output.
